_comment: The recorded model conversation for this fixture, served by
`salvor run --fixture examples/hero` with no key and no network.
Each entry is keyed by `messages`: the number of messages in the request
body when that turn reaches the model. Every turn appends to the
conversation, so turn k carries 2k - 1 messages. Selecting on that count
is stateless, which is what makes the fixture replay-safe: after a
`kill -9` and a `resume` the earlier turns are read from the durable log
and never reach the model, and the first live turn arrives with exactly
the message count it would have had uninterrupted.
`response` is an Anthropic Messages API response body, verbatim.
